task_summary: Detect USGS Michigan stations that experienced flooding (exceeded 90th percentile historical streamflow) during April 1-7, 2025, and output a CSV of station IDs with flood day counts.
decomposition_rationale: This task is a focused, single-domain pipeline (USGS NWIS data retrieval + percentile-based flood detection + CSV output). All components are tightly coupled around the dataretrieval API workflow, so a single comprehensive skill avoids artificial fragmentation.

skills.name: evo-usgs-flood-detection
skills.description: Detects flooding events at USGS streamgages by comparing daily streamflow against historical 90th percentile thresholds using the dataretrieval package. Use when analyzing flood occurrences over a date range for a list of USGS station IDs.
skills.responsibility: End-to-end pipeline: parse station list file (preserving leading zeros), fetch daily values and historical statistics via dataretrieval.nwis, compute flood-day counts via percentile threshold comparison, and write filtered results to CSV.
